title: Triadic Capital：AI巨额资本开支靠债务，但生产力证据尚未显现
speaker: Monica Schell

segments.en: So, you know, I think that the worrying part is how much more you're going to raise capex just through debt because obviously you have a whole capital structure.
segments.zh: 令人担忧的是，企业通过债务筹集更多资本开支，毕竟整个资本结构都在那里。

segments.en: And at some point you're going to need to produce more cash, you know, operationally and then maybe raised through equity or CB market.
segments.zh: 到了某个时点，你需要通过运营产生更多现金，或者通过股权或可转债市场融资。

segments.en: But, you know, currently, yeah, there is some weighing on that. Of course, you know, there is evidence of some widespread adoption of AI through all the industries and there's a second order, third order impact.
segments.zh: 但目前市场对此有所担忧。当然，有证据表明AI在各行业广泛采用，还有二阶、三阶效应。

segments.en: But, you know, currently there hasn't been proof out of that productivity gain, which, you know, also not only impacts kind of generally how much more it will investors take on this before, you know, seeing proof.
segments.zh: 但目前还没有生产力提升的证据，这不仅影响投资者在见到证据前能承受多少，也影响美联储的决策。
